name: Ad headline writer
why: Writes plain headlines with character counts and a glance test, the first check for print, outdoor and search lines.

name: Headline promise checker
why: Scores whether a headline's promise holds up, in line with the rule that a headline must not mislead on its own.

name: USP claim checker
why: Tests an ad claim against the offer and rivals before spend, the Reeves single-proposition check.

name: Fact-based ad copy writer
why: Builds an ad on one real product fact and shows the source of each line.

name: Tagline score card
why: Runs a tagline through pass or fail checks with a truth check, useful before a slogan becomes a lasting brand cue.

name: Type-led poster planner
why: Plans a poster that reads from across the street, matching this kit's outdoor and print rules.

name: Make a readable event poster
why: Checks that date, place and price read from a distance and match the facts.

name: Ad script read-aloud editor
why: Fixes lines that trip when read aloud, the core test for radio and podcast scripts.

name: Jingle video ad script writer
why: Writes a rhymed hook and a bar-by-bar lyric with a music brief for 6, 15 or 30 seconds.

name: Suno song and music bed prompt writer
why: Turns a jingle or music brief into a prompt for a demo bed the composer can react to.

name: Direct mail package reviewer
why: Scores an envelope line and letter before print, with a fix for each problem.

name: Keyed headline test planner
why: Plans a headline test with a unique code per version, the same keyed method used for mail and print here.

name: Offline ads experiment planner
why: Sets up one small offline ad test with costs, measures and a keep, change or stop rule.
